meta.name: baoyu-format-markdown
meta.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加标题、摘要、加粗等格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速美化文章或笔记的排版
copy.tagline_en: Add titles, summaries, bold, and more to plain text or Markdown files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly beautify the layout of articles or notes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你把纯文本或 Markdown 文件整理成结构清晰的 Markdown 格式，包括添加标题、加粗、列表、代码块等，并自动修复中英文间距和标点问题。
howto.when: 当你要求“格式化 Markdown”、“美化文章”、“添加格式”或改善文章布局时触发。

say.text: 帮我格式化这篇 Markdown 文章。
say.note: Claude 会分析内容并添加标题、加粗等格式。

say.text: 美化这段纯文本，加上标题和列表。
say.note: Claude 会将其转为结构化的 Markdown。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude transforms plain text or markdown files into well-structured markdown with frontmatter, titles, bold, lists, code blocks, and typography fixes (CJK spacing, quotes).
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout.

say_en.text: Format this markdown article for me.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and add formatting like headings and bold.

say_en.text: Beautify this plain text with headings and lists.
say_en.note: Claude will convert it to structured markdown.
